title: Case: Recipient disputes a recorded failed delivery attempt
context: A failed-attempt scan is disputed. The carrier must review its record without assuming the customer or driver is dishonest.
initial_request: I was at home and did not hear the intercom. Please review the missed attempt and arrange another visit. I am available on 2028-02-13 morning.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
My parcel DL-57603 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Dispatch review team, Larkspire Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask dispatch to review the attempt record and arrange a new attempt.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Larkspire Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask dispatch to review the attempt record and arrange a new attempt. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: A corrected stop error is not proof of fraud; the replacement attempt remains pending.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Review DL-7992’s failed-attempt record against the delivery stop, and arrange an available repeat attempt on 2028-02-13 morning. Please report the review finding rather than infer fault.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-013: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
